# Version 4.155.2
> **Security and WebAssembly fixes** · Released November 17, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.155.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.155.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.155.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.2/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.2 backports six upstream Skia security fixes and restores WebAssembly builds that link C sources. Managed APIs, the C API and the native ABI are unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Security

- **GPU clip and rounded-rectangle fixes** — Backports fixes for a Graphite clip render-step overflow (CVE-2026-126871) and skewed elliptical rounded-rectangle geometry in Ganesh, whose radii are now clamped (CVE-2026-126882). — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5793](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5793))
- **High-severity Skia fixes** — Backports fixes for 64-bit image-filter unique IDs (CVE-2026-118340), SkSL invalid-type rejection (CVE-2026-119261), a region-builder out-of-bounds write (CVE-2026-121086) and an analytic antialiasing blitter heap overflow (CVE-2026-126912). — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5797](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5797))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly apps linking C sources build again** — The WebGPU C++ bindings are now compiled into libSkiaSharp.a, so WebAssembly apps that add their own native C sources, such as Uno Platform 7, link successfully. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5797](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5797))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.2

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
